DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. THE COURT DETERMINES THAT PLAINTIFF FAILED TO EXHAUST HER ADMINISTRATIVE REMEDIES CONCERNING HER CLAIM FOR 2008 WAGES AND VACATION PAY IN THAT SHE HAS NOT YET SUBMITTED TO THE GRIEVANCE PROCEDURES OF THE COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FOR 2007 VACATION PAY WAS NOT A PART OF THIS CASE, AND THE COURT MAKES NO DETERMINATION CONCERNING THAT ISSUE. APPEARANCES BY BOTH SIDES. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. COMMISSIONER PAUL SLAVIT. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
